name: GridScan-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The full pink grid corridor is brightest here, with the scan band lit across the floor and walls.

tagline: A pink wireframe corridor tilts with the cursor as a scan sweeps.
summary: A perspective grid room drawn in thin pink lines, with a black void at the far end. The whole space leans and skews toward the pointer, and a bright band repeatedly travels down the corridor.
appearance: A one-point perspective box: grid lines run across the floor, walls and ceiling toward a dark rectangle in the middle. Lines are thin and magenta-pink on black, brighter near the centre where the scan light passes.
behaviour: The room pivots and skews as the pointer moves, easing back to centre once it leaves. A soft pink band slides along the corridor on a loop, and a click can fire an extra scan that ripples through.
search_phrases: 3d grid tunnel that follows the mouse
glowing lines converging to a point
use_when: A tech or product page wants an immersive depth backdrop that reacts to the pointer.
avoid_when: You need light backgrounds or heavy text: the scene is near-black with a saturated pink glow.
customise: Line colour, thickness, style and jitter, grid scale, scan colour and timing, pointer sensitivity and post effects are props. The room geometry is baked into the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen Three.js scene with optional bloom and chromatic aberration renders every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and always animating, with no reduced-motion check and no keyboard counterpart to the pointer tilt.

issues: The opening second is almost entirely black until the first scan light crosses the room.
polish_why: Convincing depth and a well-timed scan; the pink saturates and hides grid detail.
title: Grid Scan
